# AirPulse Copilot instructions

## Personal contact data

- Never add, restore, infer, expose, or suggest the site owner's personal phone number anywhere in this repository or in generated website content.
- Do not add phone-number contact fields, `tel:` links, telephone metadata, structured-data telephone properties, or phone-number placeholders for the site owner.
- Keep public contact information limited to the contact details that are already intentionally published in the repository.
